# Documentation Excellence v4.6 R1.1 — Dokumentbibliotek

The document library is now consistently called **Dokumentbibliotek** in the
Swedish user interface. The popup action says **Öppna Dokumentbibliotek**, and
the dashboard window title, empty state and accessible names use the same term.

Documentation Excellence remains the product name. Internal namespaces,
modules, architecture, pipelines and historical release terminology are
unchanged. Navigation, keyboard shortcuts, Review behavior and stored data are
unaffected.
